description: Use when an agent needs to know whether an email address can plausibly receive mail. Returns syntax, MX, disposable-domain, role-account and free-provider checks with a deliverable_likely, risky or undeliverable verdict and its reasons. No SMTP probe. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

email.description: the address to check, up to 254 characters
